title: Tarik Hasani
_note: A1.3: the Collector, cornered. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

brave.speaker: Tarik
brave.text: You. Farmer. The one who was so brave at the market.

start.speaker: Tarik
start.text: [Shaking, trying jovial.] The farmer! From the market! Brave. You were so brave. Look, it was never personal.

choices.spoken: He ate at my table. You put him there.
Who gave the order for my farm?
You're going to tell me everything. Then we'll see.
I'm the message. You get to read it.

babble.speaker: Tarik
babble.text: It was Bahram! Bahram Kesh! He picks the farms! He said the woman was special, a woman from the old country, he said she had something! I didn't know what! He's at the old stair on the north shore, him and his dogs! Please!

choices.text: [Spare him] Run. Tell them who sent you.
choices.spoken: Run. Tell every one of them who sent you.

do.run: flag tarik.done; free tarik_road; name tarik_road

choices.spoken: Walk. Saltreach can decide what you're worth.

do.run: flag tarik.done; free tarik_road; name tarik_road
